items.headline: South Korea upgrades growth forecast, raises benchmark rates to highest in two years
items.summary: The central bank raised rates by 25 basis points to 3.25% for its final meeting of the year, in line with expectations from economists.

items.headline: Nvidia's billion-dollar board bet: Who's protected as lawsuits mount?
items.summary: Nvidia's board is under investigation, and directors are already defendants in a shareholder lawsuit accusing them of failing to properly oversee the company.

items.headline: K-beauty stocks rally as Korean brands top Amazon bestseller lists globally ahead of Black Friday
items.summary: South Korean beauty stocks rose as K-beauty brands dominated Amazon's skincare rankings ahead of Black Friday.

items.summary: Japan's Nikkei 225 rose 1.21% in early trade, while the Topix edged 0.71% higher. Australia's S&P/ASX 200 was up 0.15%.

items.headline: Volatility-weary US investors side swiped as tariff mayhem adds to tech pain
items.summary: The US on Wednesday proposed a series of country-specific tariffs on goods from 14 major trading partners, including India, Japan and the European Union, while applying an additional 20% tariff on imports from China.

items.headline: SpaceX wins FCC approval to deploy 1 million orbital data center satellites
items.summary: SpaceX won approval from the FCC to put 1 million orbital data center satellites into space, a proposal that was opposed by Amazon and other groups.

items.headline: S&P warns Nvidia credit rating could be cut over 'rising' management and governance risk
items.summary: S&P Global Ratings said Nvidia's credit rating could be cut by one notch as it flagged "rising" management and governance risk at the chipmaker.

items.headline: ‘Your booth is waiting’: Denny’s welcomes Jensen Huang back as Nvidia CEO
items.summary: Denny's reaffirmed its longstanding ties with Jensen Huang following his return as Nvidia CEO, revealing that a plaque had been restored.

items.headline: Mizuho extends global banking push to India with Avendus deal
items.summary: Gaurav Deepak's Avendus Capital has completed a deal with Mizuho Financial Group to ensure operational independence. The acquisition allows Avendus to leverage Mizuho's extensive network and international expertise in investment banking. Deepak engaged in lengthy discussions before finalizing details of the agreement, which included preserving Avendus's brand identity. As the firm continues to grow, it plans to pursue an eventual stock-market listing.

items.headline: Norse Atlantic flights suspended after warning finances 'critical'
items.summary: Norse Atlantic suspended flights as it warned its financial position was "critical." The airline is seeking short-term financing and exploring a potential takeover.

items.headline: Where the market may be mispricing risk most: AI boom, volatility, high-yield bonds
items.summary: The AI boom could trigger a recession, but data centers remain an attractive investment opportunity, a hedge fund manager said.

items.headline: Nvidia’s China link revealed? Investigation claims two US-based firms with Chinese owners are buying most advanced chips
items.summary: Nvidia is selling its most cutting-edge chips to at least two companies that are US-based, but are actually controlled by Chinese-owned firms, a CBS News investigation found.

items.headline: Hedge funds are no longer just for the rich. They’re coming for everyday investors
items.summary: Hedge funds are increasingly courting retail investors as the industry seeks new avenues for growth.

items.headline: Inside India newsletter: Roaring economy, foreign investors’ return and now record auto sales
items.summary: Automakers in India are poised to sell over 30 million vehicles in the financial year ending March 2027.

items.headline: Macy's postpones Thanksgiving Day Parade due to severe weather
items.summary: Macy's announced Wednesday that its annual Thanksgiving Day Parade is being postponed to Saturday due to severe weather.
